subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Context-free calculations to 20

show.line: Friends of ten! Seven and three make ten. Six and four make ten. Every number has a friend of ten.

rounds.prompt: Seven dots are in the ten frame. How many empty spaces? Tap the number.
rounds.praise: Three! Seven and three make ten.
Four! Six and four make ten.

rounds.prompt: Eight fingers are up. How many are down? Say the number.
Which pair of numbers are friends of ten?
rounds.praise: Yes! Five and five make ten.
One! Nine and one make ten.

rounds.prompt: Do these two numbers make ten? Put each card in its group.

hints: Use your ten fingers. Put some up. Count the ones still down.
Count on from the first number until you reach ten.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the friend of seven.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Seven and three make ten. Seven and four is eleven.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count on together. Seven, eight, nine, ten. That is three more!

parent_line: Knows the pairs of numbers that make 10.
